World-class equipment includes a custom-built track, athletic rig, and performance cardio areas Swim Slip into infinity-level water under a sculpted ceiling of light. Mind & Body A space to focus and relax. The sculptural, curved ceiling and walls in our hot yoga studio promote calmness and serenity. Can’t spot the heaters? We use Europe’s only infrared-mirrored panels to create a range of temperatures suited to each class. This is a yoga lovers paradise. Changing Rooms Our changing rooms are more boutique hotel than gym. With natural skin, hair care products and fluffy towels finish each workout refreshed, relaxed and ready for the world. Sauna & Steam Embrace the heat: a hydrotherapy pool with massage jets, secluded Red Cedar Sauna, or marbled ceramic steam room, with eucalyptus-infused steam to clear your pores and airways. Emerge relaxed and refreshed. Cycle Go deeper: a cycle amphitheatre with unique light displays and sound tracks designed for each class. Ride high with tiered bikes for the best view. Test your endurance with headwinds from industrial turbines. State of the art facilities, London’s best trainers, a pool and wet-spa to recharge your batteries. A wellness retreat on your doorstep. The latest Eleiko strength training area with 12m sled track and functional training rig. Stretch and mobility areas with myofascial release. Reformer Pilates Find your balance in our dedicated Reformer Pilates studio with an energizing ambience that will that will enhance your training and 20 reformers for optimum athletic conditioning. Studio Immersive with adaptive lighting. MyZone heart rate connectivity and full surround sound. UV treated fresh air systems. Cardio Dedicated cardio area for focused training. A full range of assault bikes and SkiErgs, and the latest Woodway and Technogym Skillrun treadmills. Change Restore and recharge with luxurious salt walled sauna, waterfall cool down shower, chilled towels and our Wash Dry Fold service. Round the corner from Soho’s original, Third Space Mayfair is grown up luxury training. It’s in the big things, like the Eleiko strength training area, Reformer Pilates studio and award winning personal training and it’s in the little things; like UV treated fresh air, a Himalayan sea-salt walled sauna and steam room. FIND US 22 Clarges Street, London CLUB HOURS Monday – Friday 05:30 – 22:00 Saturday – Sunday 08:00 – 20:00 Bank holidays – 08:00 – 20:00 CONTACT 0207 042 6440 GENERAL MANAGER Matthew Brittain Club Facilities Train 12m sled track Eleiko strength training area Performance Cardio Reformer Pilates 18-person capacity Reformer Pilates studio Studio Immersive Space Adaptive lighting for High-intensity and Yoga Surround sound Sauna & Steam The Contrast Therapy facilities at Third Space Mayfair are made up of a Himalayan salt walled Sauna and a marble tiled steam room. This, alongside our ice baths form a complete Contrast Therapy offering. Changing Rooms Waterfall cool down drench shower Lemon and verbena chilled towels Wash Dry Fold service Cowshed products GHD hair dryers and straighteners Dyson Airwrap Recovery Hyperice Hypervolt, Hypersphere, and Vyper vibrating foam rollers Normatec recovery boots Ice Bath Ice baths form part of our Contrast Therapy offering at Third Space Mayfair, alongside the sauna and steam room. Performance Lab The Performance Lab at Third Space Mayfair is part of our advanced fitness testing offering, that gives you the tools and data to elevate your physical performance, health and longevity. More information can be found here. Award-winning classes led by the best instructors in London. Third Space Mayfair offers a huge range of classes that make fitness fun. Filter: All Mind & Body Pilates Sports & Performance Strength & Conditioning Sound Bath Sound Bath Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated. Lift – Weightlifting Classes Lift – Weightlifting Classes Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer. The WOD – Workout of the Day The WOD – Workout of the Day Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. Metaburn Metaburn A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout. Formula 3 Formula 3 This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises. Get fit in 3… 2… 1 Speed Fiends Speed Fiends Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand offer motivation and guidance on your running form. HYROX Train HYROX Train Develop your functional fitness to become the ultimate hybrid athlete and train to take part in a Hyrox fitness race event. Learn and improve exercise techniques to make every rep count. Attend up to 12 weeks of our progressive programming to get race ready. Dynamic Reformer Dynamic Reformer Minimal rest, maximum results. Increase the tempo in this advanced reformer class. Traditional Reformer Pilates Traditional Reformer Pilates Using spring tension to support and challenge you, expect to stretch, strengthen and tone in this full-body workout. Fundamental Reformer Pilates Fundamental Reformer Pilates No experience necessary. Whether you’re a Reformer beginner, healing from an injury, or want a slower class, start building your foundation here. Find your Personal Trainer Aston Burke Flynn Aston Burke Flynn Mayfair Aston understands everyone has individual needs and uses a meticulous approach to tailor programs to every one of his clients. Ayden Isaac-George Ayden Isaac-George Mayfair Ayden is known for getting the best out of his clients, not only when it comes to physical training but across all aspects of life. Blayne Wenlock Blayne Wenlock Mayfair Blayne has a deep passion for fitness and movement and more importantly helping people discover their potential. Harrison Stevens Harrison Stevens Mayfair Having achieved a 1st class degree in Sport and Exercise Science, a Masters in Strength and Conditioning and brings a wealth of knowledge to all of his clients training sessions. Hayley Irwin Hayley Irwin Mayfair With a solid background in injury rehabilitation, Hayley takes a personalized, holistic approach to fitness to help her clients achieve long-term success. Heather Walford Heather Walford Mayfair With a background in Professional Dance, Heather has transformed both her physique and mindset through her personal journey of lifestyle changes and confidence barriers. Josh Brewster Josh Brewster Mayfair Whether it’s a performance, aesthetic or well-being goal, Josh helps build long-standing habitual changes that result in sustained success. Kimon Demetriou Kimon Demetriou Mayfair Kimon specialises in strength and conditioning, body composition and Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Marianna Ashton Marianna Ashton Mayfair Marianna focuses on building an environment of trust with her clients and supporting them to push their limits. Stuart Pearce Stuart Pearce Mayfair Having worked as a sports performance coach for several professional sports clubs for almost a decade, including the Premier League, GB youth and professional basketball, and West Ham United Academy, Stuart has learnt that small changes made consistently can yield phenomenal results. Along with his experience, Stuart brings a breadth of knowledge to provide you with the best quality experience in every session. Darius Amoh Darius Amoh Mayfair Darius uses a holistic coaching approach, coaching optimal movement, improving strength, implementing recovery methods. Wiz Anderson Wiz Anderson Mayfair Wiz is a Personal Trainer and Nutritionist specialising in weight loss and strength training for both men and women. She takes a holistic approach to fostering physical and mental confidence, blending targeted strength training with personalized coaching to empower her clients for lasting success. Isabel (Wiz) Anderson (Nutrition) Isabel (Wiz) Anderson (Nutrition) Mayfair Wiz is highly experienced in helping individuals who find themselves stuck in the office, constantly ordering takeout, and unsure of where to start with their nutrition and fitness. Tom Wright Tom Wright Mayfair Tom is committed to helping you move freely, build lasting strength, and perform at your best, all while enhancing your longevity and quality of life. Alexandra Sasebes Alexandra Sasebes Mayfair Combining expertise in injury rehabilitation and strength training, Alex is a qualified osteopath and sports therapist whose passion is to help clients build physical strength, confidence, and resilience. Josh Putt Josh Putt Mayfair With his experience and education, Josh will help you reach your goals efficiently, focusing on results while making the process enjoyable. You’ll work together as a team, with your progress as the priority. Shea Jozana Shea Jozana Mayfair With over 10 years of experience, Shea has a proven track record of achieving results through extensive knowledge of health and fitness. Olivia Galvin Olivia Galvin Mayfair With over 8 years in the fitness industry, Olivia prioritises both the physical and mental wellbeing of every client. Known for a warm, approachable personality combined with depth of knowledge she creates a supportive environment where clients feel comfortable and confident. Be part of something bigger. Membership Membership Membership Group Plus £325 Includes use of all Third Space Clubs. Book a Tour – Moorgate Book a tour Book a tour Book a tour Overview Club Facilities Classes Trainers Rates Elite-level training Step onto the gym floor and feel inspired. Performance cardio, Eleiko strength areas and velocity-based training technology. Find balance Secluded from the city, find your balance in our dedicate Reformer Pilates studio, with noise-reducing fabric walls and warm walnut finishes. Enter the zone A circular, caged zone brings the atmosphere of martial arenas. Padded walls, hanging bags, perimeter lighting. In your element Wood. Water. Stone. Atmospheric male and female saunas, each bathed in the glow of a backlit Himalayan salt wall. Recline and unwind. Cycle in the round Descend the spiral ramp into a special circular cycling studio. Go further with ICG connect technology – for race and battle features – state-of-the-art interactive lighting and studio-quality surround sound. Escape the city Take wellness to a new level. Warm up, cool down and recover faster with compression sleeves, percussive therapy guns and recumbent relaxation chairs, all set amongst warm timber finishes. Ready for the world Luxurious changing rooms with polished concrete surfaces, terrazzo vanity stations and metallic lockers. Step into your club and leave the city behind. A high-spec fitness club for tomorrow, Third Space Moorgate features world-class training and immersive recovery facilities set in epic industrial design. FIND US 16 South Place, London CLUB HOURS Monday – Friday 05:30 – 22:00 Saturday – Sunday 08:00 – 20:00 Bank holidays – 08:00 – 20:00 CONTACT 0207 970 0930 GENERAL MANAGER Shanti Campbell Club Facilities Train Sled track & Eleiko strength area Circular combat arena HIIT studio Intelligent cycling area Cardio area Recovery lounge Mind & Body 20-person capacity Reformer Pilates studio 16-person capacity Mind & Body studio Cycle Cycle studio Interactive lighting Studio-quality surround sound Recovery Hyperice Hypervolt, Hypersphere, and Vyper vibrating foam rollers Normatec recovery boots Changing Rooms Sauna Cowshed products Fluffy towels Iron boards GHD hair dryers GHD hair straighteners Premium locker (rented monthly), and optional wash, dry and fold service Award-winning classes led by the best instructors in London. Third Space Moorgate offers a huge range of classes that make fitness fun. Filter: All Combat Cycle Mind & Body Pilates Sports & Performance Strength & Conditioning Sound Bath Sound Bath Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated. Just Ride Just Ride Switch off. Just Ride. Tempo cardio intervals with climbs and sprints. Lose yourself in the music. Lift – Weightlifting Classes Lift – Weightlifting Classes Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer. Afterburner Afterburner A high-intensity class that pushes EPOC (excess post-oxygen consumption) so that your body keeps working even after the session has finished. Sweat X Sweat X Sweat with a purpose as you split the time equally between running and strength on and off the treadmill. Transform your training as you torch calories, build endurance and unleash your strength with this high intensity focused class set to an incredible playlist. Suitable for all levels. Pick up a headset from the instructor before the class starts. The WOD – Workout of the Day The WOD – Workout of the Day Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. Metaburn Metaburn A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout. Pulse Pulse Set to the beat of the music, this low-impact barre workout uses ballet and Pilates-inspired isometric strength training techniques. Formula 3 Formula 3 This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises. Get fit in 3… 2… 1 Speed Fiends Speed Fiends Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand offer motivation and guidance on your running form. Find your Personal Trainer Amy Kerr Amy Kerr Moorgate Amy brings 8 years of experience and continued learning to her coaching. Her sessions are challenging but always grounded in quality of movement, with a core belief that moving well and often is key to a healthy life. Andrei Bugnariu Andrei Bugnariu Moorgate Andrei helps clients toward their goals to become fitter, stronger, faster, feel better and more confident in the gym. Fraser Kitching Fraser Kitching Moorgate A background in competitive sports has helped Fraser understand how to motivate and work strategically to get the best out of clients. Jessica Underwood Jessica Underwood Moorgate Jessica specialises in strength training, with a focus on body re-composition, muscle growth and fat loss. Marek Polnik Marek Polnik Moorgate Marek is a Personal Trainer with over 10 years of experience. He specialises in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and is BJJ Master Trainer at Third Space. Simone Agostini Simone Agostini Moorgate Whether you want to reach new levels of sporting performance or improve your health by building fitness and strength, Simone will guide you towards your goals. Teya Kindred Teya Kindred Moorgate Teya focuses on long term behaviour change to integrate fitness and high performance into day to day lives whilst delivering excellent physical transformations and results for clients. Sophia Underwood Sophia Underwood Moorgate Bringing her own experience from her journey as a high-performance athlete, Sophia’s enthusiasm for developing people shines through her fitness philosophy, helping inspire individuals to move better with confidence even on their worst days. Milly Isaac Milly Isaac Moorgate With a background in gymnastics and dance, and a decade of training experience, Milly brings a deep understanding of movement and performance to every session. Kenny Mbongo Kenny Mbongo Moorgate With over 7 years of experience, Kenny has helped hundreds of busy professionals achieve their best physical shape through tailored, results-driven training. With experience in football, boxing, BJJ, and MMA, he combines athletic performance with lasting physique transformation. Georgia Newman Georgia Newman Moorgate Georgia draws on over seven years of coaching experience and ongoing learning to make every session effective and enjoyable. She believes that focusing on movement quality and training smartly is the key to building strength, confidence, and fitness for life. Zack Amzil Zack Amzil Moorgate Zack is a performance coach helping driven individuals build strong, resilient bodies through structured, results-focused programming. He works with ambitious clients who value accountability and high standards to achieve sustainable, measurable progress. Petros Riska Petros Riska Moorgate With 10 years of coaching under his belt, Petros brings a wealth of experience, expertise and a positive fitness philosophy to his clients. His fitness philosophy for nearly a decade focuses on inspiring clients to move better and be stronger, even through their toughest days. Sam Thompson Sam Thompson Moorgate With over 5, 000 coaching hours, Sam helps busy, high-performing professionals build serious strength and muscle while undoing the stiffness and low energy that comes with demanding careers. His training delivers results that carry from the gym into everyday performance. Chris Rait Chris Rait Moorgate Drawing on his experience as a GB gymnast, Chris believes health and performance start with how you move. That same precision now shows in 9 years of coaching, built around your goals, the way you move and the life you actually live. Lisa Melenyuk Lisa Melenyuk Moorgate Lisa helps clients build strength, improve body composition and move better, with training built around what each person actually needs. Her approach adapts as life does, through busy periods, injuries, pregnancy or menopause, so progress continues no matter what else is going on. The goal stays constant: helping people get stronger, healthier and more confident. Be part of something bigger. Book a Tour – Moorgate Book a tour Book a tour Book a tour Overview Club Facilities Classes Trainers Rates Elite-level training Step onto the gym floor and feel inspired. Performance cardio, Eleiko strength areas and velocity-based training technology. Find balance Secluded from the city, find your balance in our dedicate Reformer Pilates studio, with noise-reducing fabric walls and warm walnut finishes. Enter the zone A circular, caged zone brings the atmosphere of martial arenas. Padded walls, hanging bags, perimeter lighting. In your element Wood. Water. Stone. Atmospheric male and female saunas, each bathed in the glow of a backlit Himalayan salt wall. Recline and unwind. Cycle in the round Descend the spiral ramp into a special circular cycling studio. Go further with ICG connect technology – for race and battle features – state-of-the-art interactive lighting and studio-quality surround sound. Escape the city Take wellness to a new level. Warm up, cool down and recover faster with compression sleeves, percussive therapy guns and recumbent relaxation chairs, all set amongst warm timber finishes. Ready for the world Luxurious changing rooms with polished concrete surfaces, terrazzo vanity stations and metallic lockers. Step into your club and leave the city behind. A high-spec fitness club for tomorrow, Third Space Moorgate features world-class training and immersive recovery facilities set in epic industrial design. FIND US 16 South Place, London CLUB HOURS Monday – Friday 05:30 – 22:00 Saturday – Sunday 08:00 – 20:00 Bank holidays – 08:00 – 20:00 CONTACT 0207 970 0930 GENERAL MANAGER Shanti Campbell Club Facilities Train Sled track & Eleiko strength area Circular combat arena HIIT studio Intelligent cycling area Cardio area Recovery lounge Mind & Body 20-person capacity Reformer Pilates studio 16-person capacity Mind & Body studio Cycle Cycle studio Interactive lighting Studio-quality surround sound Recovery Hyperice Hypervolt, Hypersphere, and Vyper vibrating foam rollers Normatec recovery boots Changing Rooms Sauna Cowshed products Fluffy towels Iron boards GHD hair dryers GHD hair straighteners Premium locker (rented monthly), and optional wash, dry and fold service Award-winning classes led by the best instructors in London. Third Space Moorgate offers a huge range of classes that make fitness fun. Filter: All Combat Cycle Mind & Body Pilates Sports & Performance Strength & Conditioning Sound Bath Sound Bath Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated. Just Ride Just Ride Switch off. Just Ride. Tempo cardio intervals with climbs and sprints. Lose yourself in the music. Lift – Weightlifting Classes Lift – Weightlifting Classes Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer. Afterburner Afterburner A high-intensity class that pushes EPOC (excess post-oxygen consumption) so that your body keeps working even after the session has finished. Sweat X Sweat X Sweat with a purpose as you split the time equally between running and strength on and off the treadmill. Transform your training as you torch calories, build endurance and unleash your strength with this high intensity focused class set to an incredible playlist. Suitable for all levels. Pick up a headset from the instructor before the class starts. The WOD – Workout of the Day The WOD – Workout of the Day Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. Metaburn Metaburn A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout. Pulse Pulse Set to the beat of the music, this low-impact barre workout uses ballet and Pilates-inspired isometric strength training techniques. Formula 3 Formula 3 This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises. Get fit in 3… 2… 1 Speed Fiends Speed Fiends Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand offer motivation and guidance on your running form. Find your Personal Trainer Amy Kerr Amy Kerr Moorgate Amy brings 8 years of experience and continued learning to her coaching. Her sessions are challenging but always grounded in quality of movement, with a core belief that moving well and often is key to a healthy life. Andrei Bugnariu Andrei Bugnariu Moorgate Andrei helps clients toward their goals to become fitter, stronger, faster, feel better and more confident in the gym. Fraser Kitching Fraser Kitching Moorgate A background in competitive sports has helped Fraser understand how to motivate and work strategically to get the best out of clients. Jessica Underwood Jessica Underwood Moorgate Jessica specialises in strength training, with a focus on body re-composition, muscle growth and fat loss. Marek Polnik Marek Polnik Moorgate Marek is a Personal Trainer with over 10 years of experience. He specialises in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and is BJJ Master Trainer at Third Space. Simone Agostini Simone Agostini Moorgate Whether you want to reach new levels of sporting performance or improve your health by building fitness and strength, Simone will guide you towards your goals. Teya Kindred Teya Kindred Moorgate Teya focuses on long term behaviour change to integrate fitness and high performance into day to day lives whilst delivering excellent physical transformations and results for clients. Sophia Underwood Sophia Underwood Moorgate Bringing her own experience from her journey as a high-performance athlete, Sophia’s enthusiasm for developing people shines through her fitness philosophy, helping inspire individuals to move better with confidence even on their worst days. Milly Isaac Milly Isaac Moorgate With a background in gymnastics and dance, and a decade of training experience, Milly brings a deep understanding of movement and performance to every session. Kenny Mbongo Kenny Mbongo Moorgate With over 7 years of experience, Kenny has helped hundreds of busy professionals achieve their best physical shape through tailored, results-driven training. With experience in football, boxing, BJJ, and MMA, he combines athletic performance with lasting physique transformation. Georgia Newman Georgia Newman Moorgate Georgia draws on over seven years of coaching experience and ongoing learning to make every session effective and enjoyable. She believes that focusing on movement quality and training smartly is the key to building strength, confidence, and fitness for life. Zack Amzil Zack Amzil Moorgate Zack is a performance coach helping driven individuals build strong, resilient bodies through structured, results-focused programming. He works with ambitious clients who value accountability and high standards to achieve sustainable, measurable progress. Petros Riska Petros Riska Moorgate With 10 years of coaching under his belt, Petros brings a wealth of experience, expertise and a positive fitness philosophy to his clients. His fitness philosophy for nearly a decade focuses on inspiring clients to move better and be stronger, even through their toughest days. Sam Thompson Sam Thompson Moorgate With over 5, 000 coaching hours, Sam helps busy, high-performing professionals build serious strength and muscle while undoing the stiffness and low energy that comes with demanding careers. His training delivers results that carry from the gym into everyday performance. Chris Rait Chris Rait Moorgate Drawing on his experience as a GB gymnast, Chris believes health and performance start with how you move. That same precision now shows in 9 years of coaching, built around your goals, the way you move and the life you actually live. Lisa Melenyuk Lisa Melenyuk Moorgate Lisa helps clients build strength, improve body composition and move better, with training built around what each person actually needs. Her approach adapts as life does, through busy periods, injuries, pregnancy or menopause, so progress continues no matter what else is going on. The goal stays constant: helping people get stronger, healthier and more confident. Be part of something bigger. Pushing yourself to new limits has never been more enjoyable. Even the river view gives a sense of epic beginnings. Tower Bridge is pure double-height fitness inspiration – from a sprint track that brings the outdoors in, to a sauna with juniper log hot zones, a dedicated reformer pilates studio, inspiring group exercise classes to bespoke interactive lighting design. This, alongside our ice baths form a complete Contrast Therapy offering. Award-winning classes led by the best instructors in London. Third Space Tower Bridge offers a huge range of classes that make fitness fun. Filter: All Combat Cycle Mind & Body Pilates Sports & Performance Strength & Conditioning Sound Bath Sound Bath Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated. Just Ride Just Ride Switch off. Just Ride. Tempo cardio intervals with climbs and sprints. Lose yourself in the music. Lift – Weightlifting Classes Lift – Weightlifting Classes Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer. Afterburner Afterburner A high-intensity class that pushes EPOC (excess post-oxygen consumption) so that your body keeps working even after the session has finished. Sweat X Sweat X Sweat with a purpose as you split the time equally between running and strength on and off the treadmill. Transform your training as you torch calories, build endurance and unleash your strength with this high intensity focused class set to an incredible playlist. Suitable for all levels. Pick up a headset from the instructor before the class starts. The WOD – Workout of the Day The WOD – Workout of the Day Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect “EMOMs” and “AMRAPs” as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard. The WOD combines effective high intensity training and strength work in an encouraging and motivating environment. Metaburn Metaburn A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout. Pulse Pulse Set to the beat of the music, this low-impact barre workout uses ballet and Pilates-inspired isometric strength training techniques. Formula 3 Formula 3 This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises. Get fit in 3… 2… 1 Speed Fiends Speed Fiends Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand offer motivation and guidance on your running form. Andrea Mora Andrea Mora Tower Bridge Andrea aims to help individuals move better and become more confident through strength training and functional movement. Jimmy Braiden Jimmy Braiden Tower Bridge Jimmy is incredibly passionate about getting people results and changing the way they see themselves. Josh Cox Josh Cox Tower Bridge Fitness and health can be easily overcomplicated. Josh’s approach is to show his clients how simple improvement can be. Juliette Barron Juliette Barron Tower Bridge Juliette’s journey began in the Professional Dance and Musical Theatre industry, where a deep passion for fitness and inclusivity was born. Kelsey White Kelsey White Tower Bridge Kelsey’s passion lies in helping people achieve pain-free movement by restoring mobility, addressing imbalances, and enhancing strength. Liam Walter Liam Walter Tower Bridge Liam’s dedication to learning informs his hands-on coaching which prioritises client comfort, confidence, and long-term fitness. Sonny Phung Sonny Phung Tower Bridge Sonny began his journey training in Calisthenics and competing in the Ireland & UK Calisthenics competition, ranking 6th. Thomas Farrand Thomas Farrand Tower Bridge Thomas is here to help you achieve your fitness goals. Approachable, passionate, and adaptable, Thomas will work with you to deliver the results you want. Tom Lippitt Tom Lippitt Tower Bridge Tom is committed to supporting you in your fitness goals with an individualised Hybrid Training approach. Jeremy Felix Jeremy Felix Tower Bridge Jeremy’s aim is to turn you into a fitter, stronger and healthier version of you. As, ultimately, you are the person that matters the most when it comes to personalised goals. Jeremy’s mantra is, “stop waiting and wishing for things to happen, let’s make it happen. Rachel Day Rachel Day Tower Bridge Rachel is a trained classical dancer growing up with a big back ground in sport through competitive diving, tennis and swimming. She uses her training to influence how she works with all of her clients through mobility and strength training. She believes that strength training is optimal for clients to see the benefits they want in and out of the gym. George Daniels George Daniels Tower Bridge George is passionate about functional fitness, Hyrox, and running. He shares his love for lifting and fitness with his clients, focusing on strength and endurance for everyday life and fitness events. His goal is to help you build a balanced, strong, and healthy lifestyle—so you can live happily and compete with confidence. Frances Smith (Lead Nutritionist) Frances Smith (Lead Nutritionist) Clapham Junction Islington Soho Tower Bridge … With years of hands-on experience guiding individuals at various stages of their health and fitness journeys, Frances specialises in simplifying today’s often overwhelming nutrition landscape to help you find the path that’s right for you. Lee Middleton Lee Middleton Tower Bridge Lee takes a holistic approach to health and fitness, combining expertise in nutrition and strength training to help individuals achieve transformative body composition changes. Jamaal Grant Jamaal Grant Tower Bridge Jamaal’s adaptable coaching style and commitment to continuous learning underpin his proactive approach. He’s dedicated to delivering high standards, enhancing quality of life, and ensuring you feel comfortable and supported throughout your journey. Rachel Butcher (Head of Nutrition) Rachel Butcher (Head of Nutrition) Clapham Junction Islington Soho Tower Bridge … Rachel is a Registered Nutritionist specialising in performance, fat loss, and corporate wellbeing. She helps clients build sustainable habits to optimise energy, body composition, and overall health. Georgia Robert Georgia Robert Tower Bridge As an ex-professional footballer, Georgia brings elite training standards to everyday clients. Her experience taught her discipline, consistency, and how to get results without burnout, now she helps clients train with confidence and exceed their own expectations. Freddie Hackett Freddie Hackett Tower Bridge With a background in competitive calisthenics, Freddie specialises in helping busy professionals master their bodies and build real, functional strength using a combination of bodyweight and conventional gym training. Reiss Gonsalves Reiss Gonsalves Tower Bridge Reiss brings over a decade of experience within the fitness industry, combining expert coaching with an energetic and approachable style. With a strong sporting background in football, he has developed a versatile training approach that helps clients improve performance, build strength, and achieve lasting results.
